ask.title: Fix the annual price
ask.answer:
Done in `index.html`: the Team line now reads **Billed annually at $278 — save 20%**.

12 × $29 = $348, so the old line promised a discount it never gave. If you'd rather keep $348, change the copy to *“Billed annually”* and drop the claim.

ask.title: Review the Acme Pulse pricing page
ask.answer:
Three things stand out on this page:

1. **The Team price doesn't add up.** “Billed annually at $348 — save 20%” is exactly 12 × $29, so there is no saving. It should be **$278**.
2. **“Start free trial” is out of line.** It sits lower and slightly right of the other plan buttons, so the most important CTA looks broken.
3. **“No credit card required” is nearly invisible.** It's light grey on off-white (about 1.6:1). It needs at least 4.5:1 to pass WCAG AA.

I'd fix the price first: it's the one a buyer will notice.

ask.title: Align the Team plan button
ask.answer:
That's the Team plan's **Start free trial** button. It has its own offset:

```css
.plan--team .plan-cta { margin-top: 14px; transform: translateX(6px); }
```

Remove that rule so it uses the shared `margin-top: auto` like the other plans. I've made the change in `styles.css`: all three buttons now sit on one baseline.

pinpoint.explain: This line promises a 20% saving on annual billing, but $348 is exactly 12 × $29, the monthly price for a full year. With 20% off, a seat billed annually should cost **$278.40**, usually shown as **$278/yr** (≈ $23/month).
